conclusions.detail: Canonical successful receipt and byte-identical immutable workroot receipt are one process lifetime and are charged once. A missing later PROMOTION marker does not cause a second charge when receipt SHA is identical.
Different process_attempt_id values for the same task/seed/train_mode remain separate attempts. Measured unpromoted or failed attempts are added; later canonical success does not erase earlier cost.

Original or resumed attempts without a complete wait4 receipt remain cpu_seconds=null with not_measured status. Intent-only evidence remains explicitly unconfirmed and unknown. Unknown CPU is not converted to numeric zero.

Canonical six-stage worker CPU, the preserved formal_02 OOM lower bound, and measured distinct ENOSPC/resume attempts are added without duplicate receipts or nested actor/group timers. Unobserved termination tails and parent preparation/copy/validation CPU prevent a complete lifecycle-cost claim.

Consolidated training wall is explicitly the elapsed span from the original RESTART_REGISTRATION through recovery completion, including interruption and waiting. It is neither uninterrupted original-launcher wall nor a sum of parallel job wall times.

The report limits success to every_canonical_formal_worker_successful, retains original_training_launcher_completed=false and all_process_attempts_successful=false, and separately discloses historical OOM/ENOSPC failures and unknown costs.
The old zero-byte final.pt is described only as preserved incomplete bytes/SHA evidence, not a valid model or replacement for selected. Byte inequality does not establish different model states.

The exact previously passed resumer fixture helper is present in publication with SHA256 08b19c9518baada0056edba9aae57cfb56e20af6aeac6a18332e0439a5d9cef2. Its source-path provenance was added without changing the helper or original receipt and without rerunning it.

limitations: Source and artificial evidence review is not a verification of still-running formal training completion.
No formal confirmation outputs or scientific results were read or certified.
Unknown CPU, unobserved tails, launcher overhead, GPU/Joules and real provider/service bills remain outside complete measured cost.
review_conclusion: No substantive blocker found in the reviewed operational accounting/report implementation and artificial evidence.
